summary: Verified the login flow fixes end-to-end. Backend /api/auth/login returns 200 with access_token for both customadmin/admin and testpanelist/test123, and 401 with detail 'Incorrect username or password' for invalid creds and unknown users. Frontend correctly maps 401 to the exact string 'Incorrect username or password' (no generic message). Admin login lands on Admin Dashboard with all 5 tabs (User Management, All Sessions, Daily Summary, Blind Test Summary, SPPS Test Summary). Panelist login lands on Sensory Analysis dashboard (New Session card with 1/2/3 Panelist buttons + Join Session card). Session persistence via localStorage works after reload. Regression check: authenticated GET /api/admin/daily-summary/2026-06-18 returned 200 with 34 sessions (>=20 threshold; note the review request expected exactly 24, but actual dataset has 34 - likely includes blind/proficiency sessions on that date).
action_items: Non-blocking: review-request expected 24 sessions for 2026-06-18; API actually returns 34. Confirm this is expected (blind/proficiency included) or if filter needs tightening.
critical_code_review_comments: handleLogin error mapping in App.js is correct: 401 -> 'Incorrect username or password'; !error.response || >=500 || ECONNABORTED -> 'Server is temporarily unavailable...'; 30s timeout tolerates cold bcrypt. Good.

Login.js still has a legacy fallback string 'Login failed. Please check your credentials.' at line 21 - unreachable in practice because handleLogin always throws with a message, but consider removing the credentials wording to fully retire the misleading text.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview pod occasionally returns 502 (Cloudflare bad gateway) on cold start - wait ~30s and retry. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Login regression test in /app/backend/tests/test_login_flow.py can be reused. daily-summary 2026-06-18 currently has 34 sessions total.
